'''Treschyt''' was a country on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]], controlled by [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Gellack]]. The [[Messert Mines Corporation]] entered an agreement with Treschyt to mine the [[Thergum Pits]], an area that was in dispute between Treschyt and a rival nation, [[Yiszte]]. Messert provided equipment and security forces to Treschyt, and within [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], the nation of Yiszte had been subjugated. Within four [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the entire planet was under the control of Tresycht's High Priest, Gellack.
